## Highlights
### New
- Turn off Keep saved tabs after unloading in Settings › Tabs and a saved tab you unload shows an X that deletes it. The X waits a moment after you unload the tab, and on iPhone and iPad it always shows rather than on hover. The setting appears in the Heraldic and Modern styles.
### Fixed
- On Mac, a Quick Window's back and forward buttons draw in the Space's text color, so they stay visible over a dark Space in a light window, or a light Space in a dark one.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
